title: Published
empty_desc_default: Published quotes will appear here once users submit and quotes are approved.
dialog_unpublish_body: Are you sure you want to unpublish {n} {count, plural, one {quote} other {quotes}}? They will be moved back to drafts.
audit_settings_description: Configure the pilot, schedule, and OpenRouter key without leaving the quote list.
audit_schedule_pilot: Pilot: {count}/20 quotes · {reviewed}/20 reviewed by a person
audit_test_one_quote_tooltip: Run one production quote through the selected model. The result remains pending human review.
audit_test_uncertain: At least one point remains uncertain or lacks a primary source.
audit_test_error: The quote audit test did not complete.
audit_schedule_review_pilot_first: Corpus processing stays blocked until a person reviews all 20 pilot quotes.
audit_outcome_hint: Choose from documented evidence. Confirm only when a primary source supports the wording, author, and reference.
audit_notes_placeholder: Record sources checked, links, and anything that still needs review…
audit_evidence_title: Findings documented by the automated audit
audit_evidence_human_review: These findings still need human review. A secondary source or an empty search does not confirm a quote.
audit_no_evidence: No documented research is available for this quote yet.
audit_progress_hint: Automated findings wait for human review. Editing your assessment starts the review; mark it reviewed only after checking the sources.
audit_openrouter_key_remove_confirm: Remove the OpenRouter key and pause the audit?
audit_openrouter_key_remove_error: Could not remove the OpenRouter key.
audit_openrouter_key_rejected: OpenRouter rejected this key. Check it and save it again.
audit_openrouter_key_unavailable: The key is saved, but OpenRouter could not be checked right now.
audit_openrouter_key_error: Could not verify or save this OpenRouter key.
audit_openrouter_key_note: Your key is sent over HTTPS and stored encrypted. Each audit sends quote text, author and reference names, and image metadata to OpenRouter. Set a provider spending limit before enabling the pilot; public Verbatims records are never changed.
audit_openrouter_model_unavailable: The openai/gpt-5-nano model is unavailable for this OpenRouter key.
